verdict.rationale: Memory erasure is a fair axis for a stateful-memory agent platform, but the evidence never documents deleting a single memory, per-user or per-agent memory, or doing a full erasure. The closest items say memory is stored as Markdown files in a Git-backed MemFS repository that is 'transparent and controllable', and that /doctor audits duplication. Neither shows an on-demand deletion or privacy-erasure capability.
